native_output.action: Open production ReShiki CDXML and native Save As CDXML

scope: Native open/save and matched-style clipboard preserve independent contracted/internal text. Prime native Expand Label applies wrapper foreground to the internal fragment; ReShiki preserves original internal foregrounds when it expands its own imported document.
content_origin: Three-atom dimethyl ether graph with an independently authored OMe contraction; no proprietary sample captions, illustrations, or page layout.

native_matched_clipboard.result: Copy/paste into a matching Helvetica10 / 28pt-bond document preserves OMe RGB124, internal oxygen RGB0, and all internal highlights.

native_expand_label.result: Prime Structure > Expand Label replaces the internal oxygen, carbon, and bond foregrounds with wrapper RGB124 while retaining their white, cyan, and yellow highlights; the external bond stays black.

writer_assessment.existing_input: Internal O text already explicitly uses color=3, whose palette entry is exact RGB0. Internal bond also explicitly uses color=3.
writer_assessment.native_save: Prime removes these redundant default-black attributes while preserving black appearance and stored default foreground.
writer_assessment.explicit_color_zero: No evidence that replacing palette black index3 with reserved black index0 prevents the native Expand Label inheritance. Both identify black; neither is a verified lock or preservation flag.
writer_assessment.production_change: None. ReShiki import/export and its own Expand command preserve the original independent styles.
writer_assessment.unverified_probe: If needed, root can compare n color/LabelColor plus s color set to 0 versus 3 in a controlled native fixture. This would require fresh native save/expand evidence before any writer change.
